Scrape single page with WARC output enabled writes to file

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { respectRobotsTxt: false, warcOutput: "/tmp/crawlberg_test.warc" };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
